parsed.restated: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Formula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), Formula.eval f = permanentPolynomial n → (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ (Formula.variableLeaves f : ℝ) * (128 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))
parsed.proof:
have key : ∀ n : ℕ, 32 ≤ n → (0:ℝ) < 128 * Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := by
  intro n hn
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n)
  have h2 := Real.logb_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2) h1
  linarith
constructor
· intro h n hn f hf
  have h3 := h hn f hf
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (key n hn)] at h3
  exact h3
· intro h n hn f hf
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (key n hn)]
  exact h hn f hf
parsed.english: For n ≥ 32, any division-free arithmetic formula over ℂ computing the n×n permanent polynomial has a number of variable leaves L satisfying n^4 ≤ L · 128 · log₂ n.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the division by the logarithm (which is positive for n ≥ 32) so the bound becomes a plain product inequality, with the hypotheses stated explicitly.
